snippet.title: Sker Ritual – New Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The new face of Sker Ritual is here. Whether you’ve confronted Sker Island’s challenges before or have yet to cull the Quiet Ones down, now is the best time to jump in! 

Tear through endless waves of supernatural enemies in this co-op horror horde shooter. Play solo or with up to 4 players, unleash god-like Miracle powers, supercharge your arsenal, and survive devastating boss encounters on Sker Island. 
 
Arm up, face the hordes, and play NOW: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492070/Sker_Ritual/#utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=yt-link&utm_campaign=July_announcement&utm_id=gameplay-trailer  
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/sker-ritual-aac702  
PlayStation 4/5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10005307  
XBOX ONE/Series S|X: https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/sker-ritual/9MX03V2FP6PJ/0010  
 
With updated editions for Sker Ritual, we’re making the game and its content more accessible at a lower price. To read more about the changes, find our full announcement here: https://www.walesinteractive.com/post/sker-ritual-announcement-refreshed-editions 

Stay updated on all news Sker Ritual and more! 

Join us on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/EsSw4DJ4tc 
Sker Ritual on X: https://x.com/SkerRitual 
Developed by Wales Interactive: https://x.com/WalesInter 
Published by Skybound Games: https://x.com/skyboundgames
